question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '**present**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the challenges and dangers posed by sand and dust storms.
 
• The correct word should indicate the storms’ ability to pose challenges to Sustainable Development Goals.
 
• "**Present**" fits well as it conveys the idea that these storms cause ongoing challenges, aligning with the context.
 
• Other options such as "**Dawn**", "**Placate**", or "**Hone**" do not fit the context as they fail to convey the active and ongoing nature of the challenge.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dawn (उदय): **"Dawn" means the beginning of something, which does not align with the challenges posed by sand and dust storms.
 
• **Placate (शांत करना):** "Placate" means to make someone less angry, which is irrelevant in this context.
 
• **Hone (सुधारना):** "Hone" means to refine or perfect something, which does not suit the idea of challenges posed by storms.
